# The least footprint and least order where idleness is decided

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Given a Boolean decision of idleness at every step and relatum (DecidesIdle: taking no part and being Unmoved), Footprinted.least touches exactly what is not idle, contains the exchanges, and is contained in every containing footprint (least_touch_iff, least_contains, least_le). Its Joined and Precedes are contained in the corresponding relations of every containing footprint (least_joined, least_precedes); every renumbering those footprints keep is also kept by it (least_keeps), connected to reachable arrangements by sorts_iff. With decidable equality of relata, a least Boolean containing footprint exists exactly where an idleness decision exists (least_exists_iff). Participation is then decided by list membership, and idleness is decided exactly where being unmoved is decided for nonparticipants (decidesIdle_iff).

Canonical source: [OrderNormal.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/OrderNormal.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- The same Flow X X and Web X X; footprints are Nat → X → Bool, with containment stating nonparticipation and Unmoved for untouched relata.
- Construction and leastness take DecidesIdle at every step and relatum, not only a finite stretch.
- least_exists_iff and decidesIdle_iff additionally require [DecidableEq X]; the forward construction does not.

P88 connects P78/P78b’s supplied footprint to idleness in the world: first state how relations remain unmoved across a step, then use the decision to read off the least touched region. The formal condition does not establish that actual worlds have this decision. The reading is AI-authored, adopted on Ren's delegation; see integration §109.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 101 theorems of Becoming.OrderNormal all have empty axiom reports, among them Footprinted.least_contains, Footprinted.least_touch_iff, Footprinted.least_le, Footprinted.least_joined, Footprinted.least_precedes, Footprinted.least_keeps, Footprinted.least_exists_iff and Footprinted.decidesIdle_iff. The same receipt covers the package's 75 modules (including the import-only root and the bridge) with 4518 theorems/6370 declaration audits, and 22 inherited modules whose current bytes match passed receipts; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. The checker also verifies core purity: the import closure of the core (GenerativeCore, InquirySufficiency, RelationalRenewal, L1–L4 and the root module Becoming) is exactly these 77 modules, every source declaration in it has an empty axiom report (of the constants Lean generates, only the injectivity lemmas of constructors with fields, injEq, depend on propext; no source declaration uses them, and the checker lists them), and it compiles from Lean's prelude alone (the foundation's import Std removed for that run). The author's counterreview is in §109 of the integration note; there is no independent review yet.

Idleness is not derived decidable for every world, and no least Boolean footprint is constructed without that decision. Necessity is the equivalence under DecidableEq, not a concrete undecidable-idleness world. Leastness is relative to the existing Boolean footprint and Contains definitions; it does not eliminate the supplied sides of Reorders or give an ethical ranking.
